title: SearchRequest
description: POST /v1/ask body (public: /search/v1/ask). Canonical shape: search/app/server.py (class SearchRequest).

question.description: Raw user question. Whitespace-only is rejected with HTTP 400. Over 2000 CHARACTERS (not bytes) is HTTP 422 — never truncated, because an answer to a shortened question would not say that it was shortened. The same cap web_chat applies to its own input.

legal_entity.description: WHOSE search this is — REQUIRED. A missing entity is an error, never 'all of them': a permissive default is a silent cross-tenant leak. May be a unit (SKOLA_NOVA_VES_ZS), which also sees what its legal person issued as `organization`. A request built without this field gets HTTP 422.

session_id.description: Opaque session grouping. Logged to qa_query_log.session_id.

user_id.description: Who is asking. Logged. NOTE: currently trusted from the body (not a verified token) — see docs/architecture/decisions.md and a known gap.

user_school_grade.description: Ročník on one unified axis (init 120): ZŠ 1..9, SŠ 10..13 (10 = 1st year SŠ … 13 = maturita). A string of digits is accepted and coerced. The caller's UNIT decides which range is real; anything outside it — or non-numeric — is ignored with a log line, never an error, because the grade only ever PREFERS content. Absent → derived from the question text, else it does not participate.

user_role.description: Audience role, validated against code_list('role') — these three codes, NOT zak/ucitel/rodic. A HARD audience filter since init 127. When settings visibility.search_requires_role is true (the default) a missing or unknown value short-circuits before retrieval with HTTP 200, outcome='role_required' and answer_source='guard' — the caller renders that like any answer.

conversation_id.description: Groups turns of one conversation. MUST be a UUID — anything else is HTTP 422, because question_answer_log.conversation_id is a uuid column and a non-UUID used to kill the whole log row silently. Omit the field if there is no conversation to group by. Passthrough otherwise: accepted + logged, NOT used for multi-turn context (see docs/ai/caching.md).

turn_seq.description: Client-side position of this question within conversation_id. Recorded, never trusted — the client owns it and the server does not verify or renumber it.

query_id.description: Client-side id of one question, so a report can be traced from the app's own log to a question_answer_log row without matching on question text. A client is expected to reuse it as Idempotency-Key, but the server treats that header as opaque and does NOT require the two to match.

selected_answer_key.description: The suggestion the user picked (suggestions[].entry_id from a previous response). ACCEPTED AND STORED BUT NOT HONOURED: the cascade still re-matches on the question text, so sending this changes no answer today. It is logged on arrival and stored beside matched_entry_id so the disagreement can be measured before the behaviour is implemented. To act on a suggestion NOW, send its `question` back as `question` — that contract works and is what suggestions are for.

query_norm_tokens.description: Optional on-device NORM tokens (lower, no diacritics, tokenized). If present, re-normalized server-side defensively. If absent, the server derives them (prepare).

query_lemma_tokens.description: Optional on-device LEMMA tokens (pure simplemma). Must satisfy the parity contract (contracts/parity/).

query_stem_tokens.description: Optional on-device STEM tokens (pure Dolamic–Savoy light). Must satisfy the parity contract (contracts/parity/).

language.description: Language filter: a code_list('language') code among the active rows. Restricts BOTH document retrieval (effective doc language = user code, else LLM code) and the QA packs. An unknown code is HTTP 422 VALIDATION_ERROR with fields pointing at language. Allowed codes are available from GET /v1/code-lists. null = no restriction.

domains.description: THEMATIC AREAS the search is restricted to: DOMAIN codes from GET /v1/domains for THIS legal_entity. Absent or null = the search that ran before this field existed (no thematic restriction) — a client that never sends it is unaffected. A non-empty set is OR between the areas and AND with every existing filter. The server normalises (trim, upper-case, deduplicate, sort) and echoes the result in effective_scope.domains; order and duplicates therefore carry no meaning, including for the Idempotency-Key digest. REJECTED with HTTP 422 and `fields` pointing at `domains` or at the offending element: [], an empty or whitespace-only element, an unknown or inactive code for this school, and a wrong type. One bad code fails the WHOLE request — the set is never silently narrowed. A valid code that labels no content is a successful request that may answer no_answer; the search never widens itself back to every area. Membership is validated against edu_ai.resolved_taxonomy_rules(legal_entity, 'DOMAIN'), which is nearest-owner-exclusive: a code from another school's catalog is unknown here even though it exists in the database. NOT A PERMISSION — it can only remove sources; entity, role, visibility and validity are unchanged behind it. If the catalog cannot be read while an explicit filter is being validated the answer is 503 UNAVAILABLE (retryable), never an unfiltered search.

params_override.description: Per-request pipeline parameter overrides, merged over the active settings row. Diagnostics and A/B measurement — not something a normal client sends.

retrieval_only.description: Run retrieval and return the candidates without spending an LLM call on the answer step.

debug.description: Include the per-step cascade trace in the response. Off by default since 2026-08-13: it measured 15.3 kB of a 21.2 kB answer, diagnostics a normal client ignores. The query log keeps the full trace either way — it is stripped on the way out, not before it is recorded.
